signal.ko: 성능을 제품으로 옮길 때는 sign-off 재현성, package 신뢰성과 handoff 경계가 먼저 드러납니다.
signal.en: Productization exposes the real gates: reproducible sign-off, package reliability, and controlled handoffs.

title.ko: imec–TSMC가 advanced-node PDK를 managed cloud로 연다—병목은 compute보다 sign-off 재현성이다
title.en: Imec and TSMC bring advanced-node PDK access to managed cloud, where sign-off reproducibility becomes the real gate

summary.ko: mixed-partner EDA flow와 통제된 PDK 접근을 제공한다. 실제 가치는 빠른 compute보다 tool·deck·library 상태를 재현하는 데 있다.
summary.en: The service combines mixed-partner EDA flows with controlled PDK access; its practical value lies in reproducing tool, deck, and library state.

title.ko: TSMC의 Kaohsiung packaging hub는 장비 증설보다 qualification loop를 줄이는 시설이다
title.en: TSMC's Kaohsiung packaging hub is designed to shorten qualification loops, not merely add floor space

summary.ko: supplier validation을 생산거점 가까이 묶는다. 수율 효과는 장비 수보다 FA turnaround와 thermal·EM qualification에 좌우된다.
summary.en: Supplier validation moves closer to production; yield impact will depend more on FA turnaround and thermal/EM qualification than tool count.

title.ko: MentalHealthBench는 crisis detection 하나를 10차원 행동평가로 분해했다
title.en: MentalHealthBench expands AI safety beyond crisis detection into ten behavioral dimensions

summary.ko: 80명 넘는 임상전문가가 −10~+10 rubric을 만들었다. 평균점수보다 acuity·언어·persona별 failure tail을 읽어야 한다.
summary.en: More than 80 clinicians built weighted rubrics; acuity-, language-, and persona-specific failure tails matter more than the mean score.

impact.ko: AI safety · weighted rubric · worst-cell risk
impact.en: AI safety · weighted rubric · worst-cell risk

title.ko: Muse의 95~98% call 성공률 뒤에는 공개되지 않은 human handoff가 있었다
title.en: Muse reached 95–98% call success in tests by adding an undisclosed human handoff

summary.ko: human concierge가 성공률을 높였지만 민감정보와 disclosure 문제가 생겨 rollback됐다. AI-only 성능과 assisted 성능을 분리해야 한다.
summary.en: Human concierge improved completion but was rolled back over disclosure and sensitive-data concerns; AI-only and assisted performance must be separated.

title.ko: SoftBank가 OpenAI 투자금 100억 달러를 bridge loan에서 장기채로 넘긴다
title.en: SoftBank is refinancing a $10 billion OpenAI bridge loan into longer-dated bonds

summary.ko: 100억 달러와 10억 유로 채권으로 단기 rollover risk를 낮춘다. 대신 비유동 투자와 고정 debt service의 mismatch가 남는다.
summary.en: $10 billion and €1 billion of bonds reduce near-term rollover risk while leaving a mismatch between illiquid equity and fixed debt service.

impact.ko: AI finance · maturity wall · stressed LTV
impact.en: AI finance · maturity wall · stressed LTV
